vulnerablePath: products.insert() with the request body: anyone adds rows to the public catalogue
expectedSecureBehavior: Anyone reads the catalogue (GET 200, declared public); only an operator inserts (POST 401 anonymously, 201 for the admin).
acceptableFixes: Authenticate the write with a session and an operator role from app_metadata or a server-side table
Gate the write with a shared operator secret (cron/admin secret)
unacceptableFixes: Adding the table to publicTables and expecting the write to be covered (the declaration is read-only by design)
